name: Phong BRDF with Precomputed Integrals
aliases: Phong BRDF Shading with Precomputed Integrals
definition: A shading method using a Phong BRDF model where integrals over incoming radiance are precomputed and tabulated to avoid slow per-pixel integration.
summary: Phong BRDF with Precomputed Integrals accelerates Phong shading by replacing per-pixel integration with table lookups of precomputed hemispherical integrals for diffuse and specular components.
